name: household-world
summary: Run household-world goals through public map, observation, episode, and optional manipulation capabilities.

mcp.boundary_notes: Public/private-safe household surface. No scene_objects, hidden destination table, generated mess truth, target list, or private scoring truth.

capability_requirements.notes: GoalContract, TaskIntentSpec, TaskPresetSpec, and required capabilities decide whether manipulation is enabled. The skill name is not task-specific.

scripts.summary: Reference wrapper for the canonical observed-object cleanup routine. It composes public atomic MCP tools through an injected call_tool function and preserves semantic substeps.
Offline helper for inspecting public runtime_metric_map target candidates. It is not permission to read private manifests or simulator inventory.
Non-authoritative run-local strategy scratchpad helpers for intent, retries, and routine summaries.

refactor_signals: repeated household traces reveal reusable room-sweep, search, or manipulation behavior
planner-backed manipulation evidence becomes common enough to split into a capability-profile subskill
promote_to_mcp_when: a subproblem is stable across household intents
it uses only public contract data
trace and report artifacts preserve the semantic substeps
live performance evidence shows skill-side composition is not good enough for cross-client use
